# AI Act classification: pace-cnn 0.1.0

Not legal advice. Classification by the provider under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, references checked 2026-10-20 (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by the digital omnibus (in force 2026-07-27)).

- **AI system (Art. 3(1)):** yes. The int8 weights are published together with the C engine and the input preparation, so the release is usable as a machine-based system that infers an activity class from motion-sensor windows (Art. 3(1)).
- **General-purpose AI model (Art. 3(63)):** no. A small task-specific classifier for six activities; it does not generate content and is not capable of a wide range of distinct tasks; compute many orders of magnitude below the indicative 10^23 FLOP of the Commission GPAI guidelines (July 2025). Parameters: 7,000. Estimated training compute: 300000000000.0 FLOP (fine-tuning; method: Own upper estimate: about 354,000 multiply-accumulates per window (QModel), 6,288 training windows, 20 epochs, forward and backward pass (factor 3) and 2 FLOP per multiply-accumulate: about 2.7e11 FLOP, rounded up to 3e11. No base model.); base model: unknown FLOP. Indicative threshold of the Commission guidelines: 10^23 FLOP and generative capability.
- **Open-source exclusion:** art2_12; monetisation: none.
- **Intended purpose:** Research, teaching and bench testing of activity recognition on microcontrollers: the model classifies 2.56-second windows of a waist-worn accelerometer and gyroscope into six activities (walking, walking upstairs, walking downstairs, sitting, standing, lying), as a baseline for pedestrian and micromobility sensing. Status: experimental, not ready for production use.
- **Out of scope:**
  - Monitoring or evaluating persons at work; decisions on access to insurance, credit or services from a person's movement; identifying or profiling persons; fall detection or any other safety function; transport-mode or vehicle classification; sensor placements other than the waist.
- **High-risk (Annex III):** none (no use in biometrics, critical infrastructure management, employment, education, essential services, law enforcement, migration or justice is intended; the card names the employment and essential-services uses as out of scope). **Annex I / safety component:** none; safety component: no. A research baseline on a test bench; not placed on the market as a component of a product under Union harmonisation legislation and not a safety component; fall detection as a safety function is out of scope.
- **Transparency obligations (Art. 50):** none (no interaction with natural persons, no generated content).
- **Export control:** not listed (Regulation (EU) 2021/821, Annex I). An activity classifier for inertial sensor windows; no cryptography, no intrusion software, no surveillance function.
